articles.title: 3-day enforcement operation nets 256 errant commercial vehicle drivers
articles.content: TP officers also detected 99 violations, which included the offence of displaying improper licence plates. They have since been referred to the Land Transport Authority for follow-up. Thee people, aged between 34 and 47, were also caught driving without a valid licence and using a vehicle without insurance coverage. Heavy vehicles found exceeding their regulated speed limits will be required to undergo inspection to verify that their speed limiters are functioning properly.
